_readme: Seed data for the BTO launches feature. One launch object per BTO sales exercise. TO SEED A NEW LAUNCH: follow the curation runbook in BTO.plan.md section 8 at the repo root step by step (finding the Annex A PDF, extraction, geocoding, sanity checks, the reused-project-name check, verification) — don't wing it from memory, the URL patterns and edge cases in there were each hit for real. resale_flat_type values must exactly match transactions.flat_type ('2 ROOM','3 ROOM','4 ROOM','5 ROOM','MULTI-GENERATION'). Prices are 99-year-lease indicative prices, excluding grants, as officially quoted by HDB unless the launch has not happened yet (see section 8.9 for provisional/unofficial launches).

launches.label: November 2026 BTO (upcoming)
launches._curation_note: NOT YET LAUNCHED — HDB has not published an official press release or Annex A for this exercise. Every project below is PROVISIONAL, sourced from third-party BTO preview blogs (not HDB), and every 'flats' entry has price_min/price_max = null since no pricing exists yet. Project names are location/estate labels used consistently across trackers, not confirmed final HDB project names. Unit-type breakdowns are included only where a source gave an unambiguous, internally-consistent count (Mattar, Caldecott's BTO portion, Tengah Garden Avenue, Chencharu, Sembawang North); Bayshore's two sites have no clean per-type split reported, so their flats stay empty with the known aggregate noted in location_desc. REPLACE all of this with real data from BTO.plan.md's curation runbook once HDB's official Annex A is published after the launch.
